selectionStrategy.allocation: 12 candidates per controlled pilot domain; strongest-domain matches are used before documented secondary-title matches.
selectionStrategy.evidencePriority: Reviews, consensus statements, trials, longitudinal designs, and measurement studies rank ahead of lower-signal title matches.
selectionStrategy.diversityPriority: Each domain attempts to reserve places for named-sport evidence, underrepresented population signals, and identifiable primary studies.
selectionStrategy.screenedPaperPolicy: Every full-text INCLUDE decision remains selected under its reviewed primary domain; EXCLUDE and DEGRADED records are not selectable.
selectionStrategy.status: Mixed screening queue — full-text-eligible records are synthesis-ready; title-screened records still require source, eligibility, taxonomy, extraction, and synthesis review.
